last_completed_event.summary: Delivery Orchestration v1.1 passed an independent blueprint audit and is now the controlling release plan. The correction moves small control state to a conflict-safe Git event ledger, keeps Drive as the bulky-artifact and projection layer, fixes three mandatory end-to-end user journeys, limits infrastructure-only milestones and repeated repairs, and requires installable Android and iOS artifacts before the release can be called complete.

system.next_safe_action: Create the minimum Android and iOS application shells around the proven shared core and make Journey J1 launchable. Produce the first Android debug APK no later than Product milestone 009. Do not add another backup, infrastructure, or audit-only checkpoint before an installable artifact unless a release-blocking defect makes the delivery slice impossible.
